links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no reading-level instruction (unspecified prompt), compared with fifth- and seventh-grade prompts
links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading level of LLM-generated dermatology patient education materials
links.effect: Common conditions: FKRL 9.8-11.21 unspecified vs 4.22-7.43 (fifth-grade prompt) and 5.98-7.28 (seventh-grade prompt). Rare conditions: 9.85-11.45 unspecified vs 4.22-7.43 and 5.98-7.28. Current AAD PEMs averaged 9.35 (common) and 9.50 (rare).
links.tradeoff: Results varied by model and grade level. Not every model reached the fifth-grade target, and for rare conditions at seventh grade ChatGPT-3.5 and DocsGPT outperformed GPT-4.
links.quote: For common diseases, the FKRLs of LLM-produced PEMs ranged between 9.8 and 11.21 (unspecified prompt), between 4.22 and 7.43 (fifth-grade prompt), and between 5.98 and 7.28 (seventh-grade prompt).
